svg.title: K7 state change and rigid handling - overview
svg.desc: Front and top view of the K7 cell with an animated Wiener-Schnitzel sequence.
svg.text: gantry: X, Y, Z quill, wrist pitch, jaw
both views to the same scale
limp, +4 °C: floppy, sticks, cannot be gripped
laid on flour; lid sheet on top
pressed flat to 5 mm and floured in one stroke
between −25 °C plate and cold slab: freezes from both faces
rigid at −5 °C: handled like a part, held by one corner
breaded, fried 180 °C: crust thaws in seconds
served; the tray is washed and back in the rack
Physics (section 3.1): a 6 mm cutlet is a rigid plate after 55–115 s;
it stays rigid 5–10 min in room air. Flour goes on before freezing
because a frozen surface does not get tacky.
Dashed = rear strip (behind the front row). Animation time is compressed;
real times: CC 115 s, frying 2 × 3.5 min, slot wash 70 s per item.
K7 — State change and rigid handling (ZUSTAND cell)
Soft food is first frozen rigid between −25 °C plates (or skins loosened by heat);
then one gantry with a single wrist handles it like parts on trays.
1/8 The gantry pulls a cold tray from rack R, lays it on the grate T2 over the sink; the sifter cup dusts flour
2/8 Tweezer tongs take the limp cutlet from the pack on T1 and drag-lay it on the tray (the one limp pick)
3/8 Press P pulls the platen onto the 5 mm gauge rails at 1 kN: flattened and floured in one stroke
4/8 Along the rear lane into the cold cabinet CC: the comb lowers a −25 °C cold slab on top (115 s)
5/8 Out again; a 1.5 s induction flash on T1 releases the frozen cutlet from the tray
6/8 Now rigid, it is taken by one corner: dipped upright in the egg bath, laid in the crumbs
7/8 Into the hot pan on P4, turned with the turner, then out through the plating port
8/8 Slot washer: the tray hangs on the lift between spray bars (wash, rinse, steam, air: 70 s) → rack R
